name: Teruel (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Teruel (a bull beneath a star within a white ornamental cartouche).
history: Municipal flag of Teruel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Teruel arms — bull beneath a star within an ornamental cartouche
